notes.b1/j1/B-r1: A glass globe on a pedestal with a lovely glass and glow, but it reads more like a fishbowl or potion flask, and the wax stays a low pool for the first seconds.
notes.b1/j1/C-r1: The classic tapered lamp with a chrome cap and base, a hot glowing bottom and translucent soft wax, the most convincing and best staged, though the wax is slightly murky.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Clear gooey metaball wax that merges and splits, but flat gold cap and base, a dark purple liquid and a generic control panel make it feel basic.
notes.b1/j1/C-r2: A bulbous glass with chrome base, glowing wax columns that stretch, detach and sink convincingly, and a tidy panel.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: A tapered cone with a big wax mass that pools and shifts rather than forming distinct blobs, and the lamp goes almost fully black when switched off.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: A violet lamp with a good glass body, a chrome cap and a pearly wax pool that sends up soft blobs, but the wax looks pale and chalky and the blobs are blurry.
notes.b1/j2/C-r2: Gorgeous bulbous glass with glowing base and blobby wax that stretches and rises, though the odd pear shape and clean metal base read slightly less classic.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Looks like a lamp but the wax is a flat blurry mass with a hard-edged slab, the glass is a flat trapezoid, and wax seldom detaches into real blobs.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Polished violet lamp with nice glass and base, but the pale wax is foggy and blurry rather than crisp blobs and the motion is a bit murky.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Clear distinct metaball blobs that merge and split, but the flat trapezoid glass and brass cap look basic and the wax is flat-colored.
notes.b1/j2/C-r1: The most convincing classic lava lamp, with a tapered glass, glowing hot pool, soft translucent wax and an elegant waisted base.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Attractive globe on a stand with great glow, but a spherical bowl with a big cap reads more like a fishbowl or potion jar than a lava lamp.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Flat-sided cone with a big orange wax mass that sloshes as a block; reads as a lamp but the wax looks like a smooth gradient slab and the glass is barely there.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Beautiful violet glass with chrome base and glow, but the wax is pale, blurry and pools like cream, with small blobs that feel soft rather than lava.
notes.b1/j3/C-r2: Bulbous glass with warm amber liquid, glowing ember wax that stretches into columns and splits convincingly, with good glass highlights and a stylish panel.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: A round fishbowl-style globe on a stand is atmospheric but strays from a lava lamp silhouette, and the wax stays a low lumpy pool before breaking into small dots.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Brass-capped tapered lamp with crisp metaball blobs that merge and split nicely, but the flat vector look and unlit glass lack depth.
notes.b1/j3/C-r1: The most classic silhouette with chrome cap and waisted base, a hot yellow-orange glow at the bottom and lit translucent wax, with minimal centered controls that keep the lamp the hero.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Warm, cohesive egg-shaped lamp with a lovely glow and clean phone layout, but the wax is a big mass up top and a pool below with little visible stretching or splitting.
notes.b2/j1/C-r3: Most convincing lamp with a chrome base and cap, glowing violet liquid and merging, splitting wax blobs, though the phone view crops the cap and the panel is a bit generic.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Pixelated, jagged wax edges and a dark, dull tube; blobs rise but one big mass dominates and the glow is weak.
notes.b2/j1/C-r4: Atmospheric purple lamp with a bright wax pool and a tidy compact control bar, but the wax reads as small soft circles that merge only a little.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Clear lava lamp with pink-orange metaball wax that merges and stretches, but the glass is flat and the base plain.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Polished chrome lamp and staged shelf scene with a nice glow, but the wax clings to one cluster near the top and barely moves.
notes.b2/j2/C-r4: Elegant glowing violet lamp with a good base and cap, but the wax is small soft round dots that cluster at the top rather than stretching and merging.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Clear lamp shape with glow and decent merging blobs, but the glass is murky, the base is a plain cone, and the panel looks like a generic UI.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: The best-crafted drawing, with polished chrome, a pooled wax layer and a staged shelf, but the wax stays stuck in one clump near the top so the motion is weak.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: The wax renders as jagged pixelated blocks, the glass is nearly invisible, and the wax settles into one big blob.
notes.b2/j2/C-r3: The most convincing lava lamp: rich pooled wax, blobs that rise, merge and split with drips, hot-bulb glow, and a stir and cooling interaction that works.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Moody amber glow, but the bulbous vessel is unusual, the wax is a flat mass that barely moves, and the panel is cramped.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clear lava lamp with metal cap and base and blobs that rise, merge and sink, but the glass is flat and the wax is a uniform pink-orange.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Most beautiful drawing with chrome hourglass base and a gradient fluid, but the wax cluster hangs at the top and barely moves across the frames.
notes.b2/j3/C-r4: Elegant purple lamp with a soft glow and a tidy bottom control bar, though the blobs read as fuzzy pink dots rather than stretchy wax.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Warm amber glow is atmospheric, but the bulbous vessel is unusual and the wax sits as a slab at the top and a pool below with little motion.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Pixelated blocky wax edges, a dark flat glass and a single blob stuck near the top make it the weakest.
notes.b2/j3/C-r3: Convincing glass with a violet gradient, a bright hot base pool and organic blobs that stretch, merge and drip, with responsive stir and off states.
